_comment: Hand-computed golden values for engine unit tests. Every case documents its own arithmetic so a failure can be re-derived on paper.

waterFilling._comment: d={RB:2,WR:2,TE:1}, F_rem=2, pools desc. Award 1: PP(RB,3)=30 > PP(WR,3)=25 > PP(TE,2)=10 -> RB. Award 2: PP(RB,4)=20 < PP(WR,3)=25 -> WR. thetaStar = value of the last award = 25.

lineup._comment: QB40 + RB30,20,10 + WR25,15 + TE12 into QB1/RB2/WR2/TE1/FLEX2: dedicated 40+30+20+25+15+12=142, leftover RB10 takes one flex, second flex empty. L=152. Adding WR22: flex becomes 22+10, L=174, MV=22.

marginalValue._comment: Empty roster padded at replacement {QB:20,RB:15,WR:12,TE:8,FLEX:10}: base L = 20+15+15+12+12+8+10+10 = 102. Add RB eff 100: RB slots 100+15, bumped RB15 virtual wins a flex over a FLEX10 virtual -> L = 20+115+24+8+(15+10) = 192. MV = 90 = eff - flex water level - (nothing else displaced).

tiers12._comment: Three obvious clusters (gaps 9 and 15 vs within-gaps <=2), sigma 2 everywhere. k=1 SSE (unweighted) = 1880.25; best k=2 = 259.71 (ratio 0.138 > 0.10); best k=3 = 4.667+5+10 = 19.67 (ratio 0.0105 <= 0.10) -> k*=3. Boundary seps 9/sqrt(8)=3.18 and 15/sqrt(8)=5.30, both >= 1.0 -> no merge.

tierSepMerge._comment: Weak: cliff 1 with sigmas 3/3 -> TierSep = 1/sqrt(18) = 0.236 < 1.0 -> merge. Strong: cliff 20 -> 20/sqrt(18) = 4.71 -> keep.
